area: Janak Puri Near Janak Puri East Metro Station Metro Pillar No. - 541

positive_snippets: Great property! Neat and clean, food is good, and right on the road. You may get to hear traffic sounds, but then thanks to the awesome location. Keep it up!
Good ambience,  Nice service,  Helpful n kind Staff. My stay was Relaxing  n Comfortable.
negative_snippets:
The room leaves a lot to be desired and is not designed for International guests.

The bed was so hard and could not be slept on without having two extra mattresses, extra duvets AND sleeping on top of three pillows.

The bathroom also needs a complete overall. The shower was dirty and full of limescale with leaking faucet and hot water that only came out hot for a period of 5-7 minutes at all time before it turned stone cold so taking a shower to wash hair was impossible, I stayed here for nearly a month and could only wash my hair ONCE the entire time due to the water issue. Not to mention the geazer water out pipe was covered in black mold and looked like it had not been cleaned or disinfected ever.

The blinds on the windows were threadbare and need changing desperately. The rooms could be updated a bit as the tables were extremely dirty under the glass table covers and seems like they were never lifted to clean the tables. The fridge was also rusted and leaking water so needs to be replaced, desperately.

The menu is very lacking and most of the food was full of oil and made me sick twice so the only option we had was to order food from Zamato every day.

Last but not least, other local visiting guests have no manners and seemed to think it was OK to talk across the hall to their family members staying in the other rooms on our floor, by standing in their open doorways and acting as if they were at their own home. The hotel needs to be more clear with guests that they must respect other guests and keep the noise level down a bit, especially in the common areas.

Having said all of that, the staff were friendly and so very helpful with anything we ever asked for, including borrowing their business phone to order food. Cannot fault them for their service at all. However, still do not recommend this hotel, especially if an international client, unless all points noted are attended to and problems fixed.

By all means hotel was good, during our  2-3 Sept stay, the entire hotel was empty but they didn't care to promote us bigger room with big toilet & bath area. They should think about their policy of promoting customers to bigger rooms in order to retain customer. Our rooms toilet and bath so small that no one can imagine. Their complimentary free breakfast has no choice for vegetarians, I mean who wants to eat oily puri/bhaji and parathas, early in the morning.  They need to take corrective action.

I had a disappointing experience at this hotel. I left a bag just outside my door for about 10-15 minutes, and when I returned, the goodies inside were missing. Thankfully, the items were not valuable, but it was upsetting that this happened. While I understand guests are advised to be cautious with belongings, I did not expect something like this in a hotel environment. This incident has left me quite disappointed with the overall sense of security.
